acceptedAnswer.text: Ask who will do the work, how sprints and QA run, who owns the IP, how data is protected, which time zone overlap they offer and for references from clients in your region.

sections.section_heading: 3. Get IP, NDA and data terms in writing
sections.description: The contract should assign all code and IP to you, keep code in your repository, and set out how personal data is processed. European buyers should check GDPR transfer safeguards. Saudi and UAE buyers should check local data protection and residency needs.
paragraphs: The contract should assign all code and IP to you, keep code in your repository, and set out how personal data is processed. European buyers should check GDPR transfer safeguards. Saudi and UAE buyers should check local data protection and residency needs.

content.text: 3. Get IP, NDA and data terms in writing

The contract should assign all code and IP to you, keep code in your repository, and set out how personal data is processed. European buyers should check GDPR transfer safeguards. Saudi and UAE buyers should check local data protection and residency needs.
